annotations.title: Google Ads waterfall priorities and network spend caps

description: Google Ads WATERFALL AND NETWORK CAPS: which network a budget spends on first and how much the others may take. action 'read' (default), 'set' (settings) or 'clear', on the ACCOUNT DEFAULT or, with budgetId, on one campaign budget, which then wins. Every channel a campaign type supports must be in a tier and caps only go on tier2; Google says which if not. A budget's read says whether it can use these and why not. 'set' and 'clear' move real spend on the next auction: show the user, get a yes, then confirm:true; dryRun:true validates without changing anything.

budgetId.description: numeric campaign budget id; omit for the account default

confirm.description: REQUIRED true for set and clear, after the user approved

customerId.description: 10-digit account id (dashes ok); omit to use the brand’s selected default account

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

settings.description: for set: one entry per campaign type

percent.description: most of the budget it may spend, 0-100

channelType.description: campaign type: SEARCH, DISPLAY, SHOPPING, VIDEO, PERFORMANCE_MAX, DEMAND_GEN and so on

tier2.description: channels that get what is left
